remarks: Wonderful Top Floor Prime corner location co-op with numerous windows and natural light. Enjoy single level living in this spacious 1200 square feet 3 Bedroom 2 Bath home in the heart of downtown Stamford. Modern updates include white cabinetry in the kitchen with granite counters, tile backsplash and stainless steel appliances. This Open Floor plan has generous sized bedrooms and a large center hall. The Association fee includes heat, hot water, gas, sewer and taxes. Shared elevator and laundry in the building. Convenient to everything- train, several parks, schools, restaurants, several movie theaters and I-95. The community requires a co-op application and board approval. Owner Occupied Only. Perfect opportunity to own versus rent.
